verdict.rationale: Grafana's alerting engine continuously evaluates rules and sends notifications autonomously (grafana-gh-7), and Grafana Cloud's Sift tool runs 'automated investigations' to detect anomalies and surface causes (grafana-docs-33), which are background automations. However, these are rule-based/ML automations rather than AI-agent-driven autonomous workflows, and there's no evidence of a broader framework for AI-native users to configure arbitrary autonomous agentic tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose autonomous agent scheduling/execution beyond alerting and Sift, independent hands-on confirmation of Sift's autonomy, and detail on how AI-native users configure these automations end-to-end.
